params.body:
Chasing Garage Baert's Opel Mokka, which was removed from Stocklist on 16 September and was still on AS24 afterwards.

## The measurement

Of the **113 removed portal cars since 1 September, 59 have no delivery at all** — not the deletion, and nothing before it either. Spread over more than fifteen garages. Three webhooks are configured platform wide, so every portal car should reach them whichever garage owns it.

So Baert's car is not a one-off.

## The cause is not in here

I had a theory and it was wrong, which is worth stating rather than burying: that a save without a signed-in user would reach nobody, because the dealer is read off the session. It does not hold. The observer passes `$force = true`, and then the vehicle's owner decides — `VehiclePublishingTest::test_force_takes_the_dealer_from_the_vehicle_instead_of_the_session` pins exactly that, and it failed the moment I broke the distinction. I reverted that change. The line of enquiry is closed, not answered.

So the finding is open, with the number in it, and the next person does not have to re-measure.

## What is fixed, without claiming it is the cause

`getWebhooksForDealerForType()` had no `else` and no second `return`, so an empty dealer got a silent `null`. The existing test that pinned this called it **"a trap"** in its own comment: at every call site `null` reads the same as "no receivers", so a missing dealer was indistinguishable from a garage without webhooks.

It now answers an empty collection, and the caller reports the case where it does not know which garage this concerns. That removes one way for this to stay quiet. It does not explain the 59.

## Verified

`AWebhookWithoutASessionTest`: an empty dealer answers an empty collection for `null`, `''` and `0`, and an unknown dealer leaves a trace.

`VehiclePublishingTest` keeps its expectation, now the other way round, with the reason written where the old comment said "trap".

New finding `2026-09-28-een-webhook-zonder-sessie`, status open, severity `nu`, against R S2-10.7.

`phpstan` green. Local suite: the same nine failures as on a clean `main` in my environment.

One note on the diff: `WebhookRepository.php` is legacy and pint reformats the whole file. I ran it by accident, restored the file from `main`, and re-applied only the eleven lines that are mine.

## Still to do

Why those 59 sent nothing, and then a round for the cars that are gone here and possibly still live at a portal. That second part reaches into other companies' listings and should not ride along as a side effect of a fix.
params.title: A missing dealer is an empty collection, not null
